patch_description: This crossover combines the strongest elements of the two codebases: (1) the targeted worst-triangle annealing with geometric "push away from the small triangle's base line" moves, (2) the two-tier soft polish (K=8 then K=4 mean-of-smallest-areas greedy search) which empirically produced the best prior score (0.77), and (3) the current program's structured multi-start pool with crossover interpolation (interior-point mixing of good basins) plus the pentagon initializer for extra diversity. The pipeline: multi-start targeted anneal → two-tier polish per start → round-robin crossover reheat passes with pruning, always keeping the global best in the pool → final long two-tier polish on the champion. It retains the fast incremental area update idea (only recomputing areas, vectorized) and ends with a hull-area normalization to satisfy the unit-area convex region requirement, with deterministic seed 42. This should recover the ~0.77 score territory while the crossover passes add basin-mixing exploration without dominating runtime.
